text:
Maya (CS): quick retro on BrightFrame onboarding — saw a big spike in embeddings + chat during week 2, wanted to surface before the QBR.
Rohit (FinOps): saw that in the spend dashboard, +48% week-over-week, mostly embedding calls.
Avery (AE): FYI customer said they were experimenting with full-history re-embeds after each user action.
Maya (CS): exact — their workflow re-indexes every edit. we flagged recommended change but they delayed rollout.
Sam (Eng): do we have a short config we can give them to switch to incremental updates?
Maya (CS): yes — shared snippet we suggested in-thread and via ticket: ```diff
- reindex_every_change = true
+ reindex_batch_window = 300  # seconds
```
Rohit (FinOps): proposing immediate guardrails for the account before renewal: 1) soft alert at `75%` of monthly credit 2) auto-throttle embeddings to 60 rps if spend delta > 30%/24h 3) one-time retainer credit to smooth transition.
Avery (AE): can we make the throttle non-blocking and provide a fallback to cheaper quantized model? customer prefers degraded quality over outage.
Sam (Eng): yes — route to `model-embed-quant-v2` on throttle. we'll add routing config: `fallback_on_throttle: true`
Maya (CS): action items: @Rohit to set the alert + temporary throttle, @Sam to push fallback routing, @Avery to run enablement on incremental indexing, @Maya to capture customer acceptance and feedback. sound right? :white_check_mark:
Rohit (FinOps): will create the alert and an internal policy note — setting soft alert `monthly_credit_threshold = 0.75` and throttle trigger `delta_24h_pct = 0.3`. I'll drop the policy id here when done.
BillingBot: Notice: BrightFrame monthly credits = $12,000, current consumption = $8,900 (74.17%)
Avery (AE): scheduling enablement session Wed 10am PT, 30m. I'll send calendar invite and pre-reads (incremental index guide + cost playbook).
Maya (CS): also want to capture UX feedback: they said embedding latency spikes influenced them to reindex more often. need logs and latency breakdown for Wed. @Sam can you export 99p/median latencies by model for last 7d?
Sam (Eng): on it. will attach CSV to the ticket by EOD.
Rohit (FinOps): small ask for the QBR: can we include a forecast slide that models two scenarios: (A) incremental indexing adoption (current trend -> -45% embedding spend) (B) no change (status quo)? I'll draft numbers but need API call counts and token mix.
Maya (CS): I'll compile usage vectors and customer commitments. also will get customer buy-in on the retainer credit proposal.
Avery (AE): quick note — renewal flagged as medium risk if spend > 110% of credit next month. we should present the pair of mitigations in the QBR.
Maya (CS): agreed. final items: 1) Rohit to confirm alert + temporary throttle by EOD tomorrow (1768990000) 2) Sam to upload latency CSV 3) Avery to confirm invite and pre-reads 4) Maya to collect acceptance email from BrightFrame. I'll post a short summary in the renewal playbook once done.
Rohit (FinOps): ack. creating internal ticket `FINOPS-1427` and will link here.
Maya (CS): thanks team — ping me if the customer asks for a billing reprieve, I'll coordinate. :pray: 
Avery (AE): thanks all — see you Wed.
